name: Invisible Character Remover
summary: Strip zero-width characters, NBSP, odd spaces, and BiDi marks from text — with category toggles.
description: Paste text and remove invisible Unicode characters: zero-width spaces, non-breaking spaces, thin/hair spaces, BiDi embedding marks, soft hyphens, and BOM. Toggle categories, optionally convert NBSP to a normal space, then copy the cleaned result. Runs locally.

faqs.question: How is this different from the Zero-Width Detector?
faqs.answer: The detector highlights zero-width characters. This remover also targets NBSP, odd spaces, and BiDi format marks, with per-category controls.

faqs.question: What does NBSP → space do?
faqs.answer: When enabled, no-break and similar spaces become a normal ASCII space instead of being deleted, which usually preserves word separation.

faqs.question: Is my text uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Cleaning runs entirely in your browser.
